project_type: C11 language runtime with web server - custom language (vek) with Pratt parser, bytecode compiler, stack-based VM, mark-sweep GC, and HTTP server
build_system: make with clang, auto-discovers src/*.c via wildcard, links with -lm
test_framework: Custom unit test framework in tests/test_*.c (standalone binaries linked against LIB_OBJS), integration tests via tests/programs/*.ve + tests/run_integration.sh comparing stdout to .expected files
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'make clean && make' to verify build. 2) Run 'make test' and confirm unit tests pass (24/24). 3) Integration tests: 7 pass, 2 pre-existing failures (control_flow, variables) are NOT caused by our changes. 4) New stdlib tests should pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network - can download SQLite amalgamation. Linux x86_64. clang available. SQLite shared lib at /usr/lib64/libsqlite3.so but we should vendor the amalgamation for self-containment.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing stdlib patterns: each package is a separate stdlib_*.c file, registered in vek_stdlib.c via create_package() + init function. Native functions have signature Value fn(int argc, Value* args). Use gc_push_root/gc_pop_root for GC safety. Use OBJ_FLAG_PIN for long-lived objects.
key_patterns: 1) stdlib_register(pkg, name, fn, arity) adds native functions to a package map. 2) create_package(name) creates a global ObjMap. 3) stdlib_init() in vek_stdlib.c calls all package inits. 4) NaN-boxed values: INT_VAL, FLOAT_VAL, OBJ_VAL, VAL_NIL, BOOL_VAL. 5) IS_STRING/IS_MAP/IS_LIST macros + AS_STRING/AS_MAP/AS_LIST casts. 6) ObjMap with obj_map_set/obj_map_get for string-keyed maps. 7) ObjList with obj_list_push/obj_list_get. 8) ObjString with obj_string_new(chars, length). 9) GC roots: gc_push_root(val) / gc_pop_root() must be balanced. 10) vm_call(callee, argc) for calling vek closures from C.
directory_structure: src/ - all C source and headers (auto-discovered by Makefile wildcard). build/ - compiled output. tests/ - test_*.c unit tests + programs/*.ve integration tests with .expected files. Makefile - build system.
